chapters.reason: The paper explicitly replaces explicit chain-of-thought tokens with continuous latent thought vectors that guide generation, which is the core mechanism of the proposed LTMs.
The paper introduces a novel class of models that incorporate latent thought vectors as part of the model architecture and training framework, aligning with latent-space representation learning.
The paper highlights scaling dimensions such as the number of iterations in inference-time computation, which allows for trading model size for more inference steps.
